player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaiwhakatākaro {player_id} e tākaro ana i te kēmu o Pig Dice.

Ngā Ture:
- I tōu wā, ka taea e koe te '[roll]' me te '[hold]'
- Whiu 2-6: Tāpiri ki tōu katoa wā
- Whiu 1: Ngaua tōu katoa wā me te whakamutu wā
- Puritia: Tāpiri katoa wā ki tōu kai me te whakamutu wā
- Tuatahi ki {winning_score} ngā piro ka wini

Ina tōu wā, ka kitea e koe ngā kai me te katoa wā o nāianei.
Whakautu me '[roll]' ki te whiu te tīeke me '[hold]' ki te pānga tōu piro.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Ko te ahua o te kōwhiringa he pai. Whakamahia '[roll]' rānei '[hold]'.
